message.Title: Retirement: Azure SQL Elastic query - Shard_Map_Manager mode

Body.Content:
Starting March 31, 2027 Elastic query using Shard_Map_Manager external data source type reaches end of support.

Existing workloads can continue to run using Azure SQL Elastic query - Shard_Map_Manager mode, but will no longer receive updates or support from Microsoft.
